value.rationale: A local period-doubling theorem cannot rule out later additional prime-two branches. For general cubic maps the nonfixed part of the second iterate may carry up to three prime-two orbits. Here nonnegative growth factor enforces a complete all-growth positive two-cycle classification, strict one-parameter continuation, and a structurally meaningful change in endpoint scaling when the linear-growth coefficient vanishes. These are natural global dynamical facts beyond numerical bifurcation plots. High-r behavior is explicitly limited to the polynomial, not asserted to describe all physically admissible population dynamics.
